policy: Unqualified game identities are resolved against physical catalogs by separating standard forms from explicitly named costume/accessory variants and wrong associated entities. Multiple plausible pre-game print states remain visual-pending.

plausible_pre_game_physical_candidates.catalog_name: K-3PO - Printed Legs, Bright Light Yellow Eyes

records.reason: Both supported K-3PO physical releases predate the game and differ in explicit leg/eye decoration. The unqualified digital key establishes the character but not which physical print generation was used; exact release requires visual/component comparison.
Both supported Kit Fisto releases predate the game. The unqualified key does not establish cape state, so exact physical release remains a direct visual/component question.

rejected_candidate.reason: Sebulba's pit droid is a separate associated entity, not Sebulba

records.reason: The exact-name physical Sebulba is the character counterpart. The competing candidate is explicitly a Pit Droid associated with Sebulba, repeating the same possessive/association false-positive pattern found for Gasgano.

physical_candidate.catalog_name: The Grand Inquisitor - Dark Bluish Gray Uniform

later_catalog_note.status: separate 2022 release; do not assume source-equivalence without release-date/visual confirmation

records.reason: The current supported crosswalk contains the 2015 Rebels Grand Inquisitor as the pre-game physical family. A separate 2022 black-uniform release exists, so exact uniform mapping remains visual/timing pending rather than being inferred from the unsuffixed identity.

systemic_findings: Associated/possessive catalog entries such as 'Pit Droid (Sebulba)' must be excluded from identity-family support for the named owner.
When the game exposes a disguise as a separate variant, that can safely disambiguate the unqualified base profile away from the disguise physical release.
Unqualified identities still need component-state review when physical releases differ only by cape, print generation, or other decoration.
